method: Node fetch HTTP retrieval plus title, response digest and basic content identity. No full source HTML is retained. English narrative paragraphs screened against their cited HTML pages after tag stripping, lowercasing, Unicode normalization and punctuation tokenization for contiguous sequences of at least 12 words. This limited exact-phrase screen does not detect paraphrase dependence, shorter copied phrases, Hindi copying, unlisted sources, image inputs or legal clearance.
